empty.title: Nothing to batch this week
empty.body: No recipe repeats often enough inside a four-day fridge window, so everything is cooked fresh. Turn on “Cook once, eat twice” in Setup, or raise the max cooking time to bring the bigger batch recipes back into the pool.

storage.fish: Fish — eat within 2 days. Do not stretch this one further.
storage.saucy: Keeps 3-4 days and freezes well. Often better on day two.
